# `aitbc coin-requests approve`

Approve a pending coin transfer request by request ID.

## Usage

```bash
aitbc coin-requests approve [OPTIONS]
```

## Options

| Option | Type | Default | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `--request-id` | text | — | yes | The Request id. |
| `--reason` | text | — | no | Reason for approval |

## Examples

```bash
aitbc coin-requests approve --request-id <request_id>
```
